# v0.7.0b4 — Clearer adapter setup and reliable charging targets

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.**

Changes compared with stable 0.6.1:

- **Optional Waveshare setup:** recognize compatible adapters, configure their
  communication settings and enable or disable TCP login. Selected settings
  and entered passwords survive re-reading the same adapter; setup waits for
  its TCP connection after restarting and reports each stage in the app log.
- **Clearer configuration:** separate feature menus, readable controls and
  explanations in five languages. Installation guides cover USB, LAN and the
  optional independent service, with a clear distinction between configuring
  the connection and changing the adapter itself.
- **More reliable charging:** stronger checks before delayed writes, restart
  and phase changes; durable targets and pause intent through interrupted saves.
  Obsolete departure commands are cancelled, while reached targets retain
  their required stop.
- **Recovery and estimates:** improved reconnects and heartbeat Repairs,
  independent vehicle-provider failures, preserved charging-loss history and
  correct separation of costs between plug cycles.
- **Maintenance and packaging:** removed unused code, strengthened security
  and publication checks, and protected app configuration from concurrent edits.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. To receive the shared fixes in service
mode, update the app to **0.7.0b4** through **#apps-beta**, then the integration.
Ordinary service connections still support **API 2 and service 0.6.1 or newer**;
direct USB/LAN needs no app. **#apps** stays on stable 0.6.1.

TCP login uses the adapter's existing web password. It does not encrypt Modbus
traffic; firmware 1.523 has a documented authentication weakness. See
[supported adapters and recovery limits](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.7.0b4/docs/lan-adapters.md).

[Update guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.7.0b4/docs/upgrading.md)
